# Joko Widodo, Indonesia, 2024: Initial Evidence Note Scope: 2024 only. I separated background context from events in 2024. Sources are a mix of primary/official and highly credible wire coverage. | Valence | Source | Claim-level summary | QIDs | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Background | [Joko Widodo: A president who mingles with people and listens to Metallica](https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-election-joko-widodo-7a47cf5e0811bedb95914b4ba20199bf)
AP News · 2024-02-11 | AP framed Widodo’s final year as a mixed record: strong growth and major infrastructure delivery, but also a controversial capital-relocation project, criticisms of political compromise, and concerns about dynastic politics. | `7B.*`, `8B.*` | | Critical | [Indonesia students protest alleged poll interference by Jokowi administration](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-students-protest-alleged-poll-interference-by-jokowi-administration/1963424/)
Reuters via ThePrint · 2024-02-12 | Students and activists protested what they saw as Jokowi’s abuse of power in the run-up to the election, pointing to his public alignment with Prabowo and his son Gibran’s candidacy. | `7B.*`, `8B.*` | | Mixed / critical | [Indonesia court rejects election challenges, upholds Prabowo’s win](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-court-rejects-election-challenges-upholds-prabowos-win/2051948/)
Reuters via ThePrint · 2024-04-22 | The Constitutional Court rejected the election disputes and said there was no evidence of systematic fraud or presidential meddling, but the case still centered on allegations of state neutrality problems and nepotism. | `7B.*` | | Critical / mixed | [Indonesian leader spends final weeks of his term in unfinished new capital](https://theprint.in/world/indonesian-leader-spends-final-weeks-of-his-term-in-unfinished-new-capital/2264249/)
Reuters via ThePrint · 2024-09-12 | Jokowi spent his final weeks in Nusantara while the flagship project still faced delays, land issues, and weak foreign investment; he said completion could take many more years. | `8B.*` | | Favorable / official | [Presiden Jokowi Resmikan Plaza Seremoni Sumbu Kebangsaan di Ibu Kota Nusantara](https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-resmikan-plaza-seremoni-sumbu-kebangsaan-di-ibu-kota-nusantara/)
Presidential Secretariat of the Republic of Indonesia · 2024-08-14 | The presidential website shows Jokowi publicly advancing Nusantara in mid-2024 by inaugurating a new IKN landmark and presenting it as tangible progress. | `8B.*` | | Critical / mixed | [Poll shows President Jokowi's approval rating falling as he exits, but he remains popular](https://www.asia-pacific-solidarity.net/news/2024-10-04/poll-shows-president-jokowis-approval-rating-falling-he-exits-he-remains-popular.html)
Reuters via APSN · 2024-10-04 | His approval fell to 75% after the allies’ election-rule push that would have helped his youngest son, but the poll still found broad satisfaction with economic conditions. | `7B.*`, `8B.*` | | Mixed / analytical | [Analysis-A decade of Jokowi: Indonesia’s democracy icon leaves illiberal legacy, critics say](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/)
Reuters via ThePrint · 2024-10-14 | Reuters’ end-of-term analysis says Jokowi leaves behind strong growth and infrastructure, but also patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity than when he entered office. | `7B.*`, `8B.*` | | Transition / neutral | [Farewell-Welcome Ceremony for Indonesia’s President from Jokowi to Prabowo Subianto](https://setkab.go.id/en/farewell-welcome-ceremony-for-indonesias-president-from-jokowi-to-prabowo-subianto/)
Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia · 2024-10-20 | The official handover record shows Jokowi formally transferring power to Prabowo on inauguration day, marking the end of his 2024 term. | `8B.*` | Bottom line: 2024 looks like a split final year. Jokowi still had notable policy delivery and strong residual popularity, but the year was also marked by election-legitimacy controversy, accusations of dynastic politics, and persistent doubts about the Nusantara project. Note: I used broad question-family labels (`7B.*`, `8B.*`) rather than exact sub-IDs.
